steps.name: Set up job
Run actions/checkout@v4
Snapshot source
Run actions/setup-python@v5
Run actions/setup-node@v4

Run npm ci
Run python scripts/run_logged.py evidence/next-build.log -- npm run build
Run python scripts/run_logged.py evidence/npm-audit.log -- npm audit --omit=dev
Run python scripts/run_logged.py evidence/pytest.log -- python -m pytest -q --junitxml=evidence/pytest.xml
Run python scripts/run_logged.py evidence/frontend-check.log -- npm run check
Run python scripts/run_logged.py evidence/frontend-tests.log -- npm test
Run python -m benchmark.generate
Run cp benchmark/cases.jsonl evidence/synthetic-cases.jsonl
Run python scripts/run_logged.py evidence/benchmark-dev.log -- python -m benchmark.evaluate --split dev --tuning --output evidence/benchmark-dev.json
Run python scripts/run_logged.py evidence/benchmark-test.log -- python -m benchmark.evaluate --split test --output evidence/benchmark-test.json
Run python -m playwright install --with-deps chromium
Run python scripts/run_logged.py evidence/browser-native.log -- python scripts/browser_smoke.py
Run python scripts/run_logged.py evidence/browser-edges.log -- python scripts/browser_edges.py
Run python scripts/run_logged.py evidence/docker-smoke.log -- python scripts/docker_smoke.py
Run python scripts/run_logged.py evidence/upstream-isolation.log -- python scripts/upstream_isolation.py
Run actions/setup-go@v6
Run python scripts/run_logged.py evidence/archive-build.log -- python scripts/build_archive_fixture.py --output evidence/archive-image.json
Run python scripts/run_logged.py evidence/archive-integration.log -- python scripts/archive_integration.py --output evidence/archive-integration.json
Run python scripts/run_logged.py evidence/research-pipeline.log -- python scripts/research_pipeline.py --output evidence/research-pipeline
Run python scripts/run_logged.py evidence/container-integrations.log -- python scripts/container_integrations.py
Run python scripts/run_logged.py evidence/dependency-audit.log -- python -m pip_audit -r requirements-archive.txt --format json --output evidence/dependency-audit.json
Run python scripts/run_logged.py evidence/latency.log -- python scripts/measure_latency.py --samples 60 --output evidence/latency.json
Run python scripts/run_logged.py evidence/ablation.log -- python -m benchmark.ablation --split test --output evidence/ablation.json
Run python scripts/run_logged.py evidence/study-analysis.log -- python -m benchmark.research --output evidence/study-analysis.json study evidence/study-automation.json
Run python scripts/run_logged.py evidence/comparison.log -- python scripts/demo_comparison.py --output evidence/comparison.json

Inventory evidence
